newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July copper wire and cable orders up 5.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan July copper wire and cable orders up 5.6 pct.

text.p: Japan's copper wire and cable orders rose 5.6 percent in July from the same month last year to 88,500 tonnes, while shipments were up 6.2 percent year-on-year at 89,000 tonnes, the Japanese Electric Wire and Cable Makers' Association said on Tuesday.
On a month-on-month basis orders were up 7.3 percent while shipments were up 8.1 percent.
Figures for June orders were revised downward to 82,501 tonnes from 83,700, off 5.7 percent year-on-year, while shipments were revised downward to 82,316 tonnes from 82,900.

In the July figures, a continued slide in orders from the electric power generating sector was more than offset by gains in the electric machinery, automotive and construction sectors, with construction orders showing particularly strong growth of 14.2 percent year-on-year to 34,300 tonnes.

July aluminium cable orders surged to 7,800 tonnes, up 93.9 percent year-on-year and 1.3 percent month-on-month, while shipments, at 3,700 tonnes, were off 44.4 percent year-on-year and 14.9 percent month-on-month.
